question: What are the five most commonly prescribed medications for patients who were previously prescribed bupropion (sustained release) during the same hospital encounter, since 1 year ago?

tsql: SELECT T2.drug FROM (SELECT diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, diagnoses_icd.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10019172) AND diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'tobacco use disorder') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(YEAR(GETDATE()), 11, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, prescriptions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10019172) AND dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(YEAR(GETDATE()), 11, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime

question: What is the top four most frequently prescribed drugs that were prescribed to patients within the same month after being diagnosed with other psoriasis in 2100?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other psoriasis' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',prescriptions.starttime) = '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other psoriasis') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.starttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'other psoriasis' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.starttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 4 ] Output [ drug ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'other psoriasis' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_4.charttime, Scan_5.subject_id FROM Join_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Scan_5.hadm_id ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_6.charttime, Scan_7.hadm_id FROM Join_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Join_6.subject_id = Scan_7.subject_id ), Scan_9 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM Scan_9 WHERE dbo.DURING(starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Filter_10.drug FROM Join_8 JOIN Filter_10 ON Filter_10.hadm_id = Join_8.hadm_id AND Join_8.charttime < Filter_10.starttime AND dbo.DURING(Join_8.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Filter_10.starttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 4 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_14

question: What are the top three commonly ordered lab tests for patients 20s?

qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ age >= 20 AND age <= 29 ] Output [ hadm_id , age ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid ] ; #3 = Join [ #1 , #2 ] Predicate [ #1.hadm_id = #2.hadm_id ] Output [ #2.itemid ] ; #4 = Aggregate [ #3 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #5 = SequenceProject [ #4 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #6 = Filter [ #5 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.itemid = #7.itemid ] Output [ #7.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, age FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE age >= 20 AND age <= 29 ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Join_3 AS ( SELECT Scan_2.itemid FROM Scan_1 JOIN Scan_2 ON Scan_1.hadm_id = Scan_2.hadm_id ), Aggregate_4 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_3 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_5 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_4 ), Filter_6 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_5 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Scan_7.label FROM Filter_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Filter_6.itemid = Scan_7.itemid ) SELECT * FROM Join_8

question: Which were the four most frequent specimens tested since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T1.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM microbiologyevents WHERE datetime(microbiologyevents.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') GROUP BY microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc ) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 4
tsql: SELECT T1.spec_type_desc FROM (SELECT microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM microbiologyevents WHERE dbo.MET_BY(microbiologyevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1 GROUP BY microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 4

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT charttime, spec_type_desc FROM mimic_iv.dbo.microbiologyevents ), Filter_2 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc FROM Scan_1 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Aggregate_3 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_2 GROUP BY spec_type_desc ), SequenceProject_4 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_3 ), Filter_5 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc FROM SequenceProject_4 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 4 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_5

question: What amount of pregabalin had been prescribed to patient 10020944 in total during the first hospital visit?

question: What are the five most frequently ordered medications for patients diagnosed with gastro-esophageal reflux disease without esophagitis previously in the same hospital encounter, in 2100?

question: What are the top three most commonly prescribed medications since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T1.drug FROM ( SELECT prescriptions.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM prescriptions WHERE datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') GROUP BY prescriptions.drug ) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T1.drug FROM (SELECT prescriptions.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM prescriptions WHERE dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1 GROUP BY prescriptions.drug) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 3

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_2 AS ( SELECT drug FROM Scan_1 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Aggregate_3 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_2 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_4 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_3 ), Filter_5 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_4 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_5

tsql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.C1 FROM (SELECT labevents.valuenum AS valuenum, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY labevents.valuenum) AS C1 FROM labevents WHERE labevents.itemid IN (SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'glucose') AND labevents.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.age = (SELECT TOP 1 admissions.age FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10015931 AND NOT admissions.dischtime IS NULL ORDER BY admissions.admittime DESC))) AS T1 WHERE T1.valuenum = 186.0
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Predicate [ label = 'glucose' ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10015931 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ] Output [ admittime , age , subject_id , dischtime ] ; #3 = TopSort [ #2 ] Rows [ 1 ] OrderBy [ admittime DESC ] Output [ admittime , age ] ; #4 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ hadm_id , age ] ; #5 = Join [ #3 , #4 ] Predicate [ #3.age = #4.age ] Output [ #4.hadm_id ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , valuenum ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.hadm_id = #6.hadm_id ] Output [ #6.itemid , #6.valuenum ] ; #8 = Join [ #1 , #7 ] Predicate [ #1.itemid = #7.itemid ] Output [ #7.valuenum ] ; #9 = SequenceProject [ #8 ] Over [ valuenum ASC ] Output [ valuenum , percent_rank() AS percent_rank_1 ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ valuenum = 186.0 ] Distinct [ true ] Output [ percent_rank_1 ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems WHERE label = 'glucose' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT admittime, age, subject_id, dischtime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE subject_id = 10015931 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ), TopSort_3 AS ( SELECT TOP 1 admittime, age FROM Scan_2 ORDER BY admittime DESC ), Scan_4 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, age FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Scan_4.hadm_id FROM TopSort_3 JOIN Scan_4 ON TopSort_3.age = Scan_4.age ), Scan_6 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, valuenum FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Scan_6.itemid, Scan_6.valuenum FROM Join_5 JOIN Scan_6 ON Join_5.hadm_id = Scan_6.hadm_id ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_7.valuenum FROM Scan_1 JOIN Join_7 ON Scan_1.itemid = Join_7.itemid ), SequenceProject_9 AS ( SELECT valuenum, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY valuenum ASC) AS percent_rank_1 FROM Join_8 ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT percent_rank_1 FROM SequenceProject_9 WHERE valuenum = 186.0 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_10

question: How many patients since 1 year ago had taken promote with fiber (full)?
sqlite: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT admissions.subject_id ) FROM admissions WHERE admissions.hadm_id IN ( SELECT icustays.hadm_id FROM icustays WHERE icustays.stay_id IN ( SELECT inputevents.stay_id FROM inputevents WHERE inputevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_items.itemid FROM d_items WHERE d_items.label = 'promote with fiber (full)' AND d_items.linksto = 'inputevents' ) AND datetime(inputevents.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) )

question: What are the four commonly tested specimens for patients diagnosed with anoxic brain damage, not elsewhere classified previously during the same hospital visit, since 1 year ago?

question: What are the four most commonly prescribed treatments for patients previously diagnosed with long term (current) use of opiate analgesic during the same hospital visit since 2100?

qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'long term (current) use of opiate analgesic' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id , #5.hadm_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.charttime ] Output [ #10.icd_code ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ icd_code ] Output [ icd_code , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ icd_code , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 4 ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #15 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Output [ icd_code , long_title ] ; #16 = Join [ #14 , #15 ] Predicate [ #15.icd_code = #14.icd_code ] Output [ #15.long_title ]

question: What are the four most commonly prescribed drugs for patients that received laparoscopic lysis of peritoneal adhesions previously in the same month, in 2100?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'laparoscopic lysis of peritoneal adhesions' ) AND strftime('%Y',procedures_icd.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',prescriptions.starttime) = '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN (SELECT TOP 1 admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10016810 AND NOT admissions.dischtime IS NULL ORDER BY admissions.admittime DESC) AND prescriptions.drug = 'famotidine'
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10016810 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ] Output [ hadm_id , admittime , subject_id , dischtime ] ; #2 = TopSort [ #1 ] Rows [ 1 ] OrderBy [ admittime DESC ] Output [ hadm_id , admittime ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Predicate [ drug = 'famotidine' ] Output [ hadm_id , drug ] ; #4 = Join [ #2 , #3 ] Predicate [ #2.hadm_id = #3.hadm_id ] Output [ #2.hadm_id , #2.admittime ] ; #5 = Aggregate [ #4 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, admittime, subject_id, dischtime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE subject_id = 10016810 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ), TopSort_2 AS ( SELECT TOP 1 hadm_id, admittime FROM Scan_1 ORDER BY admittime DESC ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions WHERE drug = 'famotidine' ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT TopSort_2.hadm_id, TopSort_2.admittime FROM TopSort_2 JOIN Scan_3 ON TopSort_2.hadm_id = Scan_3.hadm_id ), Aggregate_5 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_4 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_5

question: How many days have it been since the first time patient 10018081 received a gt flush input in the current ICU visit?

question: What is the minimum monthly number of patient records marked with long-term (current) use of insulin?
sqlite: SELECT MIN(T1.C1) FROM ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT diagnoses_icd.hadm_id ) AS C1 FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'long-term (current) use of insulin' ) GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',diagnoses_icd.charttime) ) AS T1
tsql: SELECT MIN(T1.C1) FROM (SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT diagnoses_icd.hadm_id) AS C1 FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'long-term (current) use of insulin') GROUP BY FORMAT(diagnoses_icd.charttime, 'yyyy-MM')) AS T1

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'long-term (current) use of insulin' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, format(charttime, 'yyyy-MM') AS format_charttime_yyyy_MM_1 FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Join_3 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Scan_2.hadm_id, Scan_2.format_charttime_yyyy_MM_1 FROM Scan_1 JOIN Scan_2 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Scan_2.icd_code ), Aggregate_4 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_3 GROUP BY format_charttime_yyyy_MM_1 ), Aggregate_5 AS ( SELECT MIN(Count_Star) AS Min_Count_Star FROM Aggregate_4 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_5

question: Is glucose in patient 10021487 last measured on the current hospital visit less than the second to last value measured on the current hospital visit?
sqlite: SELECT ( SELECT labevents.valuenum FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021487 AND admissions.dischtime IS NULL ) AND labevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'glucose' ) ORDER BY labevents.charttime DESC LIMIT 1 ) < ( SELECT labevents.valuenum FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021487 AND admissions.dischtime IS NULL ) AND labevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'glucose' ) ORDER BY labevents.charttime DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1 )
tsql: SELECT IIF(lhs.val < rhs.val, 1, 0) FROM (SELECT TOP 1 labevents.valuenum AS val FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021487 AND admissions.dischtime IS NULL) AND labevents.itemid IN (SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'glucose') ORDER BY labevents.charttime DESC) AS lhs CROSS APPLY (SELECT labevents.valuenum AS val FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021487 AND admissions.dischtime IS NULL) AND labevents.itemid IN (SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'glucose') ORDER BY labevents.charttime DESC OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS rhs
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Predicate [ label = 'glucose' ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10021487 AND dischtime IS NULL ] Output [ hadm_id , subject_id , dischtime ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime , valuenum ] ; #4 = Join [ #2 , #3 ] Predicate [ #2.hadm_id = #3.hadm_id ] Output [ #3.itemid , #3.charttime , #3.valuenum ] ; #5 = Join [ #1 , #4 ] Predicate [ #1.itemid = #4.itemid ] Output [ #4.charttime , #4.valuenum ] ; #6 = TopSort [ #5 ] Rows [ 1 ] OrderBy [ charttime DESC ] Offset [ 1 ] Output [ valuenum ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10021487 AND dischtime IS NULL ] Output [ hadm_id , subject_id , dischtime ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime , valuenum ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #7.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id ] Output [ #8.itemid , #8.charttime , #8.valuenum ] ; #10 = Sort [ #9 ] OrderBy [ charttime DESC ] Output [ itemid , charttime , valuenum ] ; #11 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Predicate [ label = 'glucose' ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #12 = Intersect [ #10 , #11 ] Predicate [ #10.itemid = #11.itemid ] Output [ #10.charttime , #10.valuenum ] ; #13 = Top [ #12 ] Rows [ 1 ] Output [ valuenum ] ; #14 = Join [ #6 , #13 ] Output [ #6.valuenum > #13.valuenum AS Gr_1 ]

question: What are the top four frequent diagnoses that patients were diagnosed with since 2100 after having received a performance of cardiac output, continuous procedure within 2 months?
sqlite: SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.long_title FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code IN ( SELECT T3.icd_code FROM ( SELECT T2.icd_code, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'performance of cardiac output, continuous' ) AND strftime('%Y',procedures_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.icd_code, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.icd_code ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4 )
sqlite_ans: atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery with unspecified angina pectoris
presence of coronary angioplasty implant and graft
tsql: SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.long_title FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code IN (SELECT T3.icd_code FROM (SELECT T2.icd_code AS icd_code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'performance of cardiac output, continuous') AND dbo.MET_BY(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.icd_code AS icd_code, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.icd_code) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4)
tsql_ans: atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery with unspecified angina pectoris

question: Give me the top four most commonly prescribed medications within 2 months to the patients aged 60 or above after diagnosed with esophageal reflux since 2100.

sqlite_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)

question: For patients who took dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach since 2100, what are the top four most frequent specimens tested afterward within 2 months?
sqlite: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT T2.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach' ) AND strftime('%Y',procedures_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',microbiologyevents.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4

qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = 'dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.charttime AND #10.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#8.charttime, 'within +2 month') ] Output [ #10.spec_type_desc ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 4 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]

question: What were the five most frequent drugs that were prescribed within 2 months to patients in their 50s after diagnosed with acute pulmonary edema, since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'acute pulmonary edema' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5

question: What's the average total cost of the hospital that involves a drug called neomycin-polymyxin-bacitracin?
